title: Tool calls in a row fold into one line
body:
`Transcript::entries` in `src/session.rs` holds one `Entry::Tool` per tool call, and the screen draws each call on its own line with a blank line after it. An edit adds a `+N -M` line under its call. A turn that makes nine calls in a row takes about eighteen rows, which pushes the conversation around it off the screen.

## Proposal

- A run is two or more `Entry::Tool` in a row. An agent reply, a person's message, a thought or a notice ends it. An `Entry::Permission` row inside a run stays in it.
- A run draws folded as one line: a status dot, the number of calls, the count of each kind, and the run's combined diff, with `▸` at the right. While a call in the run is in progress, the line also shows that call's title.
- A click on the line unfolds the run into the calls as they draw today, each still foldable on its own. A second click folds it again. The fold state is kept under the first call's id.
- The grouping happens at draw time, so a session loaded through `session/load` groups the same way and the session model does not change.
- A single call between other entries draws as it does today.
- A sub-agent's `agent` line counts as one call in its parent's run.

Jack settled that a thought ends a run and that runs start at two calls. He refines the folded line once a first version is on screen.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/df584c97
notes.text: A first version landed, uncommitted on `dev`. `tool_runs` in `src/ui.rs` finds each run of two or more `Entry::Tool`, with `Entry::Permission` rows kept inside and any other entry ending it. `build_transcript` draws a run's first row with `group_row`, which shows the status dot, `N tools`, the count of each kind, the summed `+A −D`, `· K failed`, the title of a call in progress and the `▸` or `▾` marker. A folded run skips its entries. The fold key is `group:<first call id>`, kept apart from the first call's own fold, and its fold area covers only the group row, so a click on an unfolded call still toggles that call. On `scenarios/readme/thread.json` at 80 × 28 the nine calls draw as `● 9 tools   read 4 · search 2 · edit 2 · run 1   +3 −2`.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/df584c97
notes.text:
Jack reviewed the first version on screen and asked for these changes:

- Every call takes one line. An edit's `+N -M` moves onto the call's own line rather than the line under it.
- An unfolded group draws its calls indented under the group line, with no blank lines between them.
- Each kind of call gets its own icon and colour, and the kind's name takes the icon's colour: read `≡` blue, search `◎` cyan, edit `±` yellow, delete `⌫` orange, move `➜` blue, run `❯` magenta, fetch `↓` cyan, think `∴` muted, mode `◇` accent, agent and other `•` muted. Green stays out of the kinds because it means done.
- The spinner replaces the icon while a call runs, and a red `✗` replaces it when the call fails.
- The group line colours each kind's count the same way.

The ASCII stand-ins went to coax-b633ab.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/df584c97
notes.text:
The changes from Jack's review landed in `src/ui.rs`, uncommitted on `dev`:

- `tool_rows` draws every call on one line: the icon, the kind, the title, then the location and an edit's `+N −M` while they fit. The `⎿` second row is gone.
- `tool_icon` is the one table from a call to its icon and colour, so coax-b633ab can swap in ASCII there. The spinner replaces the icon while a call runs, and a red `✗` replaces it when the call fails.
- `group_row` starts with `✓`, the spinner or `✗`, and colours each kind's count like the kind's icon. It is laid out in the same width as the calls, so its `▸` lines up with theirs.
- In `build_transcript`, an unfolded run draws its calls `RUN_INDENT` in from the group row, with no blank rows between them. A permission row inside the run is laid out in the narrower width.

The spinner frame reaches the rows through a `spin` argument on `tool_view`, `tool_block`, `tool_rows`, `group_row` and the subagent helpers.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/df584c97
notes.text:
Third round, uncommitted on `dev`:

- `with_marker` gave way to `marker` and `behind_marker` in `src/ui.rs`. The fold arrow now leads the row, ahead of the icon. A call that cannot unfold gets two blank columns there. Every row of a call shifts two columns, and so does its diff or output when unfolded, which now starts at column 6.
- The group line puts the run's combined diff after the edit count, as in `edit 2 (+3 −2)`. Each count is in the foreground colour, and each kind's name stays in its kind's colour.
- `progress_line` in `src/header.rs` takes `App::show_plan` and draws `▸ plan` while the plan is hidden and `▾ plan` while it shows, in place of `▶ plan`.
